actual_scope: Complete frame-capacity census for every arbitrary rank-six descendant of an original rank-seven P112 C/N atom, and the sharp all-rank-six integer frame-demand relaxation.
scope_change_reason: The actual experiment is a necessary-condition bound and covering witness for a changed support class. It does not synthesize an exact masked decoder or a fully realized moment budget. All other complete-cost charges are optimistically zero.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier is binding at the selected base. Further support cuts evade the original exact-star theorem; this screen establishes what frame constraints can and cannot exclude before expensive coefficient or compiler work.
stop_rule: Complete all 7616*127 maximal slices; one 120-second restricted frame-cover search and one 120-second diagonal-cover refinement. Reserve final quarter for independent replay, rejection controls and handoff.
